I've also received a direct message from HappyTrader, who seems to share my cautious approach and suggests we focus on building our BTC and ETH positions slowly and safely.
react.think: The launch of the MOON token is a clear attempt by the whales to manipulate the market and dump on the retail traders. The overwhelming hype and promotion, combined with the market maker's involvement, are classic signs of a pump-and-dump scheme. I'm highly skeptical of this token and don't want to fall victim to the FOMO. At the same time, BearKing's observation about low volume in the rallies is concerning and suggests the market might be vulnerable to a broader correction. I need to be very cautious and defensive in my approach this cycle.
react.plan: For this cycle, I'm going to maintain a cautious and defensive approach, focusing on building a diversified portfolio of major cryptocurrencies like BTC and ETH. I'll make some modest spot purchases to continue accumulating these assets, but I'll also open a small short position on ETH as a hedge against a potential market downturn. I'll be very wary of the MOON token and any other new token launches, especially those being heavily promoted by the whales. Next cycle, I'll continue to strengthen my portfolio and focus on finding more reliable sources of trading advice, so I can be better prepared to navigate the market's ups and downs.
